authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.mission: Meta Ads domain planning and governed operations with financial/risk classification, paused-first writes, budgets/approvals/current authority, analytics/readback and optimization decision support.
sources: - n8n corpus: only limited Meta Lead Ads-specific reference; no inferred full coverage

tasks.title: W12-00 - Meta Ads Coordination & Financial Risk Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate W05-W08 and current policy/authority interfaces.
2. Freeze Meta Ads domain objects/capabilities, write risk classes and financial-impact boundaries.
3. Define paused-first/staging strategy, account/tenant bindings and approval/budget requirements.
4. Define measurement/readback and publication barriers.
5. Create premortem for overspend, wrong account, duplicate mutation, stale audience/creative and provider rate limits.
tasks.forbidden: Do not duplicate W08 provider transport or W07 executor.

tasks.title: W12-A - Meta Ads Domain Contracts & Capability Plans
actions: 1. Define domain intents for campaign/adset/ad/audience/creative operations using W04 capabilities.
2. Model financial impact/risk class and reversibility.
3. Preserve Meta external IDs separately from Aurora IDs.
4. Define read vs write capability boundaries.
5. Add contract/schema tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not embed credentials or executable authority in plans.

tasks.title: W12-B - Account Binding & Read Surfaces
actions: 1. Compose explicit Meta account/business/ad-account binding via W08.
2. Implement normalized reads for campaigns/adsets/ads/audiences/metrics needed by W12.
3. Validate tenant/account and freshness/provenance.
4. Treat account verification as precondition only.
5. Add wrong-account/cross-tenant tests.

tasks.title: W12-C - Creative & Audience Planning
actions: 1. Implement creative/audience candidate planning from verified facts and constraints.
2. Use W05 reasoning level appropriate to ambiguity/risk.
3. Carry evidence, confidence and budget estimates separately from authority.
4. Support deterministic templates for known safe patterns.
5. Add policy/content/targeting constraint tests.
tasks.forbidden: Confidence must never increase spend authority.

tasks.title: W12-D - Campaign/AdSet/Ad Paused-First Operations
actions: 1. Implement governed create/update operations through W07/W08.
2. Default to paused/non-serving state where supported before activation-sensitive actions.
3. Use idempotency, preconditions, current policy/authority and readback.
4. Classify ambiguous writes as EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN and reconcile.
5. Test duplicate/timeouts/rate-limits.
tasks.ownership: W12 domain commands composed over W07/W08.
tasks.forbidden: No direct provider mutation from planner/router.

tasks.title: W12-E - Financial Budget, Approval & Current Authority
actions: 1. Map financial-impact actions to required authority/budget/approval constraints.
2. Use W02 current-policy/authority validation at execution time.
3. Ensure low latency/cost goals cannot relax financial safety.
4. Fail closed on stale precheck, missing approval, budget ceiling or tenant mismatch.
5. Add overspend/authority attack matrix.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create a parallel Policy Engine or financial token.

tasks.title: W12-F - Meta Ads Analytics & Measurement
actions: 1. Normalize provider metrics/read models needed for optimization.
2. Preserve attribution/provenance/freshness and account scope.
3. Link actions to evidence/outcomes without claiming causality beyond data.
4. Expose W17/W18-compatible telemetry/eval inputs.
5. Add delayed/incomplete metrics tests.
tasks.forbidden: Analytics cannot directly authorize spend changes.

tasks.title: W12-G - Optimization Decision Support
actions: 1. Generate optimization candidates with expected benefit/risk/cost.
2. Use adaptive reasoning only as decision support.
3. Separate recommendation from ActionIntent/authority.
4. Support abstain/human review when evidence is weak or impact high.
5. Add benchmark and counterfactual-style eval fixtures where appropriate.
tasks.forbidden: No automatic spend escalation from confidence/model output.

tasks.title: W12-H - Meta Ads Reconciliation & Integration Acceptance
actions: 1. Run paused-first creation/update/readback/evidence scenarios.
2. Test wrong account, expired auth, rate limits, duplicate writes, stale policy, financial ceiling and uncertain provider state.
3. Run four Risk Gates, exact-head CI and cleanup.
4. Prove no n8n Lead Ads reference is falsely treated as full Meta Ads implementation.
5. Publish W12 acceptance/handoff.
tasks.forbidden: No production activation without explicit release/authority.
